head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
title: Deeper/broader converter-stage, raw-ASM projection, and bounded SAB evidence review
scope: Audit the current FreeCAD DWG conversion wrapper and identify what its success signal proves.
Compare GDAL DXF raw-modeler projection and ezdxf SAT/SAB API documentation at exact version boundaries.
Translate source-backed route limits into PAR-07/S8 implementation-ready evidence requirements without adding peer dependencies or fixtures.

sources.observation: The DWG-to-DXF wrapper waits for the selected converter and reports success based on the expected output path existing; the inspected path does not check the converter child-process return code.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Qualification-harness design evidence only; no converter or native FreeCAD run was made, and this does not establish a libdxfrw defect.

sources.observation: DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes ASMData and a 12-real ASMTransform for AC1027+ modeler entities; default behavior skips them because the driver cannot convert them to OGR geometry. Binary DXF input is documented beginning with GDAL 3.12.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Optional DXF carrier/projection comparison only; not DWG parsing, source-owner closure, ACIS semantics, B-rep validity, or full document retention.

sources.observation: The ACIS API documents SAT/SAB loading, export_sab, and Body-from-mesh output versioned as SAT for R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013+. The older FAQ broadly says only SAT is written. mesh_from_body only extracts flat polygonal faces and curved faces are lost.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A pinned-release check may qualify the documented mesh-origin subset; export_sab does not establish arbitrary ACIS/SAB edit or round-trip semantics.

sources.observation: Specific SAT final-block and binary DXF group-310 history provides candidate comparator probes that overlap existing local fast selectors.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Release-note leads only; pin an exact peer build and compare its observed output before drawing any per-feature conclusion.

planChanges: At PAR-07/S8 record exact converter identity/arguments/status/diagnostics, fresh intermediate hash and actual DXF version, then strict-parse the intermediate before native import.
Treat GDAL optional raw ASM output as a versioned carrier/projection check, not semantic geometry.
Separate ezdxf general arbitrary-carrier claims from bounded mesh-origin SAB generation and test the exact release/profile only at the composed checkpoint.
Keep LibreCAD and LibreCAD_3 2D compatibility separate from optional 3D semantic qualification; retain existing no-peer-per-slice and no-external-fixture policies.

method.limitations: Mutable documentation/source establishes route descriptions, not results for an exact installed peer build. No FreeCAD, GDAL, ezdxf, LibreDWG, or kernel execution was performed.

validation.planDiffCheck: PASS: git diff --check -- DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md src/libdxfrw.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp

disposition: PLAN_UPDATED; claims unchanged; six external J items remain explicitly non-promoting
